scope_correction: The reviewed document is a research roadmap, not a completed Phase 1 preregistration package. The review correctly blocks Phase 1 inference, but its contract-level omissions do not invalidate the roadmap or require changing the phase order.

decisions.reviewer_claim: The preregistration list is not yet a schema-backed, mechanically verified execution contract.
decisions.local_reasoning: Correct as a readiness finding, but the roadmap was not represented as the completed Phase 1 package. This is the next zero-call implementation task rather than a defect requiring another research-order rewrite.
decisions.binding_effect: Phase 1 inference is blocked until a manifest schema, scorer, boundary fixtures and fail-closed preflight verifier are frozen.

decisions.reviewer_claim: The 36-item selection mechanism and the scope of inference are not explicit.
decisions.local_reasoning: A controlled context pilot does not need a probability sample if it makes a finite-benchmark claim and preserves selection history.
decisions.binding_effect: The primary estimand is limited to the 12 frozen runtime-mutant items; candidate frame, ordered selection and exclusions must be recorded, with no population extrapolation.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Detection and control-candidate rates cannot be uniquely recomputed without atom matching and item-folding rules.
decisions.local_reasoning: These quantities directly determine the adopt-B gate and therefore cannot remain natural-language judgments.
decisions.binding_effect: The addendum defines item-level D, F and C indicators; the Phase 1 freeze must include a sealed atom map, deterministic scorer and test fixture.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Freeze whether missing context remains in the denominator, changes the B arm or triggers no-go.
decisions.local_reasoning: Keeping a missing-marker B arm would test a mixture of context availability and context utility. For this deliberately constructed benchmark, full context availability is a cleaner precondition.
decisions.binding_effect: Any CONTEXT_MISSING among the final 36 items fails preflight and prevents all model calls; repair or sample change requires a new preserved version.

decisions.reviewer_claim: PPS design details, inclusion probabilities and variance method are underdefined.
decisions.local_reasoning: A seed and size measure alone do not uniquely define a probability design or its weights.
decisions.binding_effect: Before Phase 2, freeze the complete frame, strata allocation, PPS algorithm/version, replacement and uniqueness rules, random draws, inclusion probabilities and design-matched uncertainty method.

decisions.topic: Phase 2 point estimate under unresolved audits
decisions.reviewer_claim: A 90% determinate threshold does not make missing audit outcomes ignorable or uniquely define a population point estimate.
decisions.local_reasoning: The original threshold was a feasibility gate, not a missingness assumption; using it to license a single population estimate would overstate identification.
decisions.binding_effect: Always report weighted lower and upper bounds; any determinate-only value is explicitly a conditional rate, and any additional point estimate requires a separately frozen missingness assumption.

decisions.reviewer_claim: The adjusted risk difference, non-GPT pooling, clustering and leave-one-item-out rule are not unique.
decisions.local_reasoning: With 12 complete blocks, a simple design-balanced item contrast is more reproducible than selecting a small-sample regression specification. Clustering is not needed to define the gate itself.
decisions.binding_effect: Use an equal-origin, item-level direct risk difference per reviewer run; balance design factors, define LOO sign including zero, and make any unestimable state no-go.

decisions.reviewer_claim: The reviewer set, origin weights and run aggregation for the own-origin control guardrail are ambiguous.
decisions.local_reasoning: The only primary interaction is for the GPT reviewer, so the confirmatory guardrail should use the same reviewer and remain run-specific.
decisions.binding_effect: Each GPT-reviewer run separately compares GPT-origin controls with three equally weighted non-GPT origins; other reviewers are descriptive.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Later phases do not specify how a Phase 1 adopt-A or adopt-B decision enters their inputs.
decisions.local_reasoning: The decision should set a default, not automatically claim applicability across natural revisions and generated-output tasks with different source mappings.
decisions.binding_effect: Every later manifest must explicitly inherit A, inherit B, or preregister context as inapplicable, together with extractor and missingness rules.

decisions.reviewer_claim: Clarify request identity, integer-equivalent gates, unique sampled units, mutation-template scope and event terminology.
decisions.local_reasoning: These are low-cost clarifications that close real implementation ambiguity.
decisions.binding_effect: The addendum supplies exact Phase 1 integer gates and a shared event-level vocabulary; Phase 2/3 contracts must encode the remaining details.
